name: 道の駅 みやま
desc: 福岡県みやま市にある「道の駅みやま」は、新鮮な地元農産物と活気あふれる特産品直売所が魅力の人気スポットです。特産品は、日本三大産地として知られるみずみずしいセロリや、皮が薄くて甘い「山川みかん」、ナスなど。直売所には安心・安全にこだわった農作物が並びます。フードコートでは、半熟卵をご飯で包んだ名物おにぎり「玉めし」などの絶品グルメも味わえ、みやまの豊かな食を存分に堪能できるのが特徴です。
descEn: Located in Miyama City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Miyama" is a popular spot renowned for its fresh local produce and vibrant farmers' market. Its specialties include incredibly juicy celery, for which Miyama is a major producing area, as well as thin-skinned, sweet "Yamakawa Mikan" (mandarin oranges) and eggplants. The market is lined with safe, high-quality agricultural products. At the food court, visitors can savor exquisite local gourmets, such as the famous "Tamameshi"—a soft-boiled egg wrapped in a flavored rice ball—allowing you to fully enjoy Miyama's rich food culture.
